score_scope: Design-plan variety and truthful concept labeling only; no new generated asset approved.

subjects.distinct_design: Defensive humanoid with dominant broad shield silhouette
subjects.implementation_review_focus: Lock shield hand and weapon hand; show attached shield grip/straps; defense posture must be distinct.

subjects.distinct_design: Long pole/harpoon and visible tether silhouette with pulling or casting posture
subjects.comparison: Prior ranged rifle infantry and non-hostile fishing equipment
subjects.implementation_review_focus: Keep hostile combat identity and tether attachment consistent; avoid using a rifle-shaped weapon or friendly fisher-only posing.

subjects.distinct_design: Compact carried ordnance load and setting/throwing posture
subjects.implementation_review_focus: Readable pack/charge shape beyond recoloring; coherent hands and attached pack straps; artwork only.

subjects.distinct_design: Low lean feline, long thick tail, rounded cat muzzle and snow-leopard-like markings
subjects.implementation_review_focus: Four legs, one tail, stable markings and natural feline paws; no added dorsal plate silhouette.

subjects.distinct_design: Low broad russet/cream bristled ungulate with paired rising tusks
subjects.implementation_review_focus: Exactly paired tusks, cloven primary hooves, one short tail; consistent snout and tusk attachments.

subjects.distinct_design: Massive shaggy shoulder and low swept lateral horns with broad bases
subjects.comparison: Giant Elk, Tundra Stag and bipedal Horned Snow Beast
subjects.implementation_review_focus: Four-legged shaggy body, cloven hooves and stable paired non-branching horns; distinguish from antlered deer and humanoid beasts.

subjects.distinct_design: Flying bird predator with two feathered wings, two legs and hooked beak
subjects.comparison: No existing flying enemy among twelve selected prior subjects
subjects.implementation_review_focus: Stable folded-wing rotation; spread-wing flight and landing details; one tail and attached coherent talons.

subjects.distinct_design: Hostile mechanical siege ram on a clearly built sled chassis
subjects.comparison: No prior enemy machine; existing worker sled/snowplow equipment
subjects.implementation_review_focus: Lock runner/support/ram counts and direction; distinct ram head and chassis, connected mechanics, contact and unclipped actions.
